name: Uketsuke Ningyou
source:
He is the "Receptionist Doll" on the third floor [spoiler] and the host of the 2nd Main Game. 

His real name is Satou Gashu (佐藤 我執) and is actually a human. He is Satou Kai’s father and Rio Ranger’s creator (but Ranger also refers to him as his father, even calling him ‘dad’) [/spoiler]
